events.title: Internet Explorer 8 released
events.summary: Microsoft released Internet Explorer 8 on March 19, 2009 with accelerators, Web Slices, InPrivate browsing, and improved standards support.
events.about: IE 8 was Microsoft's last major pre-Chrome browser push — adding developer tools, better CSS 2.1 support, and compatibility modes for IE 7/6 sites. It held majority market share while Firefox and Chrome gained ground.

narrative.whyChosen: IE 8 was the final dominant Internet Explorer before Chrome reshaped the market.
narrative.whyImportant: InPrivate and accelerators influenced privacy and browser extension patterns.
narrative.problemSolved: IE 7 lagged on standards and privacy features as competitors innovated faster.
